description: Validation rule catalog for canonical loss run documents (canonical-schema.json). All ids are PROVISIONAL: the client's R-01..R-15 catalog was not in the repo when this was built (brief 03), so ids follow the brief's must-cover order and will be renumbered to that catalog when it lands. Rules are pure data; LossRun.Rules evaluates them deterministically with no I/O, on every document including replay hits.

expressionLanguage.paths: Dotted paths into the canonical document rooted at `claim`, `period`, `document`, `context` (RuleContext) or `item` (current element inside sum/count/unique). `document.claims` is every claim across all policy periods. `{var}` placeholders are bound by `forEach`.
expressionLanguage.values: {path}, {const}, {param} (rule params), {add:[...]} (strict: null if any operand null), {sumNonNull:[...]} (nulls ignored; null only if all null), {sub:[a,b]}, {sum:{over,path}} (nulls ignored; null if all null), {count:{over,where?}}, {daysBetween:[from,to]} (to - from in days), {coalesce:[...]}, {collect:{over,path,transform?}} (array of item values; transform `year` maps dates to years).
expressionLanguage.predicates: {cmp:eq|ne|lt|le|gt|ge, left, right, tolerance?, normalize?} (numeric tolerance in USD; normalize `text` compares strings as normalized text, case, punctuation and spacing ignored, since 0.12.0), {and:[...]}, {or:[...]}, {not:p}, {allKnown:[...]} (checks only the operands whose data is present), {in:{value, values}}, {isNull:v}, {notNull:v}, {notBlank:v}, {unique:{over, key, normalize?}}, {subsetOf:{value, of}} (every element of the value array is in `of`; unknown when value is null or empty).
expressionLanguage.nullSemantics: Three-valued: a comparison with a null operand is unknown. `when` not true -> not-applicable. `assert` true -> pass, false -> fail, unknown -> not-applicable (missing data is scored by completeness, not by these rules). Since 0.4.0 a pass is reported as not-informative when a value the rule read was derived by the carrier format (lineage extractor `derived`) purely from other values the same rule read (e.g. R-02 on incurred = paid + reserve): it is listed separately and counted with n/a in pass-rate denominators; it never blocks.
expressionLanguage.severity: hard = blocks straight-through (routes to review) and counts toward the first-pass hard-rule rate; soft = warning to the reviewer/underwriter; flag = routing signal (jurisdiction split, exclude from WC metrics, lag/large-loss analytics), never an error and never counted in pass rates.
expressionLanguage.conditionalSeverity: `severity` is the default; `severityOverrides` is an ordered list of {when, severity, reason} evaluated per instance, and the first override whose `when` is true sets the outcome's severity (e.g. R-20 hard only when expenseTreatment = separate; R-07/R-08 soft for cumulative trauma).
expressionLanguage.emit: Optional {name: value-expression} map; each non-null value is returned on the outcome in RuleOutcome.values (e.g. R-23 lagDays) for analytics, whether the rule passes or fails.

rules.name: Paid does not exceed incurred
rules.message: {c} paid exceeds {c} incurred on claim {claimNumber}.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H5; NCRB USR edits 000082/000083

rules.name: Incurred equals paid plus reserve (±$1)
rules.message: {c} incurred is not {c} paid + {c} reserve (±$1) on claim {claimNumber}.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H6; Milliman casualty glossary (incurred = paid + case reserve)

rules.name: No negative amounts outside recovery columns
rules.message: {c} {m} is negative on claim {claimNumber}; recoveries belong in recoverySubrogation.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H10; Kentucky data reporting ('No negative amounts may be entered')
rules.caNote: Carriers sometimes print paid net of recoveries in parentheses; the normalizer must route those to recoverySubrogation rather than store a negative paid.

rules.name: Closed claims carry zero reserves
rules.message: Closed claim {claimNumber} still carries a {c} reserve.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H9/S9 (soft per brief 03); MA stat plan status 1 'no future payments are expected'; Racklify red flag 'Closed claims that still appear open'

rules.name: Medical-only claims carry zero indemnity
rules.message: Medical-only claim {claimNumber} has indemnity {m}; it may have converted to indemnity.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H8/S8; NCRB USR edit 000069 (incurred indemnity must be zero for injury code 6 or 7)

rules.name: Date of injury not after valuation date
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} date of injury is after the run's valuation date.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H3

rules.name: Date of injury not after date reported

severityOverrides.reason: Cumulative trauma: CA LC 5412 date of injury can be set after the claim is reported.

rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} was reported before its date of injury.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H3; brief 03 Answers 6 (soft for CT)
rules.caNote: For CA cumulative trauma the LC 5412 date can be set after the claim is reported, so this rule is soft for CT claims; review rather than auto-correct.

rules.name: Date of injury falls within the claim's policy period

severityOverrides.reason: Cumulative trauma: CA LC 5412 DOI may post-date the exposure period / employment.

rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} date of injury is outside its policy period.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H4/S4
rules.caNote: CA cumulative trauma: the LC 5412 date of injury requires disability plus knowledge of industrial causation and can fall after employment ended (B3; ~60% of CT claims are filed post-termination), so this rule is soft for CT claims.

rules.name: No duplicate claim numbers within the run
rules.message: Duplicate claim numbers on the run (after normalization).
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H2; NCRB USR edit 000066
rules.caNote: A run spanning carriers/TPAs may legitimately repeat a number across carriers (B4 S2); split such runs per carrier before applying this rule.

rules.name: Policy-period money subtotals reconcile to claim rows (±$1)
rules.message: Printed {c} {m} subtotal for policy {policyNumber} does not equal the sum of its claim rows.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H11; strategy report (printed subtotals are the free oracle for the learn loop); not applicable to summary-only periods (brief 03 Answers 2)

rules.name: Policy-period claim counts reconcile to claim rows
rules.message: Printed open/closed/total claim counts for policy {policyNumber} do not match the claim rows (reopened counts as open).
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H12; TJC loss run 'Summary Total For' Open/Closed/TOTAL blocks; not applicable to summary-only periods (brief 03 Answers 2)

rules.name: Grand money totals reconcile to all claim rows (±$1)
rules.message: Printed grand total {c} {m} does not equal the sum of all claim rows.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H11; not applicable when any period is summary-only (brief 03b Answers 1; R-26 covers those runs)

rules.name: Grand claim counts reconcile to all claim rows
rules.message: Printed grand-total claim counts do not match the claim rows (reopened counts as open).
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H12; not applicable when any period is summary-only (brief 03b Answers 1)

rules.name: 'No losses' statement means zero claim rows for that policy period
rules.message: Policy period {policyNumber} states no losses but claim rows were extracted for it.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H13; Vouch ('no losses were reported'); NJ 291A ('NONE'). Scoped per policy period since 0.5.0 (ADR 0016): real runs print 'no claims for this policy year' for some terms and claim rows for others (brief 17, P8). A document-level statement no period can take applies to every period

rules.name: Valuation date is current for the quote
rules.message: Valuation date is more than {maxDays} days before the target policy effective date (stale loss run).
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B3/B4 S16; State Fund: 'valued within 100 days of the policy inception date'
rules.caNote: 100 days is State Fund's requirement; other CA carriers use 30/60/90 days (ICW, Foresight). Set maxDays per receiving carrier. Not applicable without RuleContext.targetPolicyEffectiveDate.

rules.name: Reopened claims show an open reserve
rules.message: Reopened claim {claimNumber} has no open reserve.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B2 Inferences and B4 S14 (single-valuation part only; cross-valuation reopen detection needs the claim history store, brief 09). Brief 08 eval run: the prior-close-date part was dropped — many formats print no close-date column, so it failed every reopened claim of those carriers (4 on one 43-claim run → review) without saying anything about the claim.

rules.name: Jurisdiction is California
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} is not a California claim; CA experience rating uses CA USR data only.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B3 Inferences; B4 S19; flag per brief 03 Answers 6 (routes to jurisdiction split)

rules.name: Line of business is workers' compensation
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} is not a WC claim (mixed-line run).
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 S20; lossrx ('coverage must be filtered first'); flag per brief 03 Answers 6 (exclude from WC metrics)

rules.name: Claim number present when incurred exceeds $2,000
rules.message: A claim with incurred over ${threshold} has no claim number.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H1; NCRB USR edit 000077

rules.name: Total columns equal the sum of components (±$1)

severityOverrides.reason: Expense is printed in its own columns, so the identity must hold.

rules.message: Total {m} on claim {claimNumber} is not indemnity + medical + expense (±$1).
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H7; brief 03 Answers 6 (hard only when expenseTreatment = separate); not applicable when the format declares totals of indemnity + medical only (ADR 0018, R-29)
rules.caNote: Not applicable when a component column is absent; soft unless the carrier format declares expense as separate columns.

rules.name: Reported and closed dates are consistent with injury and valuation dates
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} has a report or close date after the valuation date, or a close date before the injury.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H3 (extended to report/close dates); AMS360 close date auto-filled from final payment

rules.name: Net incurred below gross requires a recovery amount
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} shows net incurred below gross incurred but no recovery amount.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 S10; WCIRB ERP subrogated-claim rule (gross × net/gross); CDI Peeters decision on timely subrogation reporting

rules.name: Report lag within the allowed days
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} was reported more than {maxLagDays} days after the date of injury.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B3/B4 S17 (Workforce.com: lag between date of loss and date reported); threshold per brief 03 Answers 8

rules.name: Large loss
rules.message: Claim {claimNumber} total incurred is at or above the ${largeLossThreshold} large-loss threshold.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 S18; threshold per brief 03 Answers 8 (analytics caps such as $250K trend or the $1M NCCI cap are metric params, not this rule)

rules.name: Every requested policy year is on the run
rules.message: One or more requested policy years have no policy period on the run.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 S15; State Fund (four years of loss runs); WCIRB (no mod on partial data); brief 03 Answers 8
rules.caNote: Policy year = calendar year of the policy effective date. Not applicable until the submission context supplies RuleContext.requestedPolicyYears (brief 11).

rules.name: Period subtotals sum to the grand totals (±$1)
rules.message: Printed grand total {c} {m} does not equal the sum of the policy-period subtotals.
rules.source: brief 03b Answers 1; evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H11 (applies to summary-only runs, where R-12 cannot)

rules.name: A policy period with no claim rows says so
rules.message: Policy period {policyNumber} has no claim rows, no printed totals and no 'no losses' statement: confirm the term really had no claims.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H13 (companion of R-14); ADR 0016 (brief 18, P8): the third case of the per-period no-losses rule. A routing signal, not an error: an empty term without a statement is usually a term with no claims, but it is also what a missed table looks like. Summary-only periods (printed totals) are not empty

rules.name: A 'no losses' statement is tied to a policy period
rules.message: The run prints a 'no losses' statement, but every policy period read lists claims: a period heading was probably not read.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H13 (companion of R-14 and R-27); brief 18 Answers 3: the mirror of R-27, a routing signal for the reviewer

rules.name: Indemnity + medical totals equal their components (±$1)

severityOverrides.reason: Expense is printed in its own columns, so the named components must add up to the total.

rules.message: Total {m} on claim {claimNumber} is not indemnity + medical (±$1), as its header names.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 H7 (as R-20); ADR 0018: a header naming its components ('Total Incurred (Ind+Med)') declares the sum the verification checks

rules.name: Claim status is printed or verified
rules.message: Claim status is unknown on some claims: the format prints no status and deriving it from the close date was not verified against printed open/closed counts.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 (status vocabulary); brief 19 Answers 2: status from the close date only per format and verified, otherwise unknown and flagged

rules.name: Kept rows of other lines have a printed total to reconcile against
rules.message: Rows of another line of business were kept, not extracted, and the run prints no total to reconcile the workers' comp rows against: check that no kept row is a workers' comp claim.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B4 (reconciliation); brief 23 Answers 1 (ADR 0020 amendment): a flag shown in the review panel and the manifest, not a review trigger

rules.name: The valuation date is printed on the run
rules.message: The run prints no valuation date: the date is as stated by the submitter.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B1 (valuation date); brief 23 Answers 2: the submission's valuation date is used, never silently (lineage source submission; quote payload and pricing memo state it)

rules.name: Carrier and insured are different names
rules.message: The carrier name and the insured name are the same: one of them may have been read from the other's label. A self-insured employer can print its own name as both; confirm which.
rules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B1 (carrier and insured, header-block fields); brief 35 §4 (brief 34 wake, corpus v5 c8: the insured delivered as the carrier on every replay). Soft, never blocking: a self-insured employer legitimately prints one name as both

quoteRules.name: Required for quoting

conditions.summaryOnlyLabelledPeriod: Period dates are required whenever the document has claim rows (a claim without a policy period cannot be allocated). They are not required for a period of a document without claim rows that is summary-only and carries its own year or range (periodLabel or periodKind, ADR 0017).

quoteRules.message: A value the quote needs is missing or not yet verified.
quoteRules.source: evaluation-and-wc-domain.md A2 (key fields per claim); brief 24 step 2, review plan 2026-10-25 section 1 change 3, brief 24 Answers 1 (conditional period dates): quote readiness only, never document routing (the evaluator does not read quoteRules). Field list is an assumption to confirm with underwriting
